text:
sec-oncall: Alert: configuration drift in SAML connector caused long-lived federated sessions for svc-* accounts.
sec-oncall: Immediate actions: revoke federated sessions, disable federation, rotate any persistent keys, and run audit on recent assume-role events.
idp-admin: confirmed: assertion expiry enforcement was accidentally removed in last deploy. Rolling back now.
sso-bot: detected spike of SAML keep-alives from 34.120.10.22 between 02:04-02:28 UTC.
alice: ack. Which services are affected?
sec-oncall: preliminary: svc-deploy, svc-ci, svc-monitoring. Treat all federated sessions as suspect.
bob: revoking sessions and rotating keys for svc-deploy and svc-ci. New keys pushed to Vault with tag rotated-after-saml.
infra: disabling federation issuance and enabling CI fallback tokens (short-lived) for emergency deploys.
eng-manager: will draft exec note once containment verified. Any customer impact?
sec-oncall: no evidence of data exfiltration. Audit in progress; forensics assigned for one odd assume-role from IP 198.51.100.45.
alice: commands: `idpctl sessions list --filter "principal:svc-*"` then `idpctl sessions revoke <id>`; `splunk query` for AssumeRoleWithSAML events.
sec-oncall: add unit tests in infra repo to assert assertion_expiry_enforced=true in connector config.
bob: containment status: sessions revoked, IdP fix applied, token rotations underway. ETA verification: 2h.
eng-manager: thanks, please keep this thread updated and add postmortem within 48h.
